clips.title: The story
paras: At the Tower of Althalaxx, the Cult of the Dark Strand's hold has been broken. Word of the victory travels south to Delgren the Purifier in Ashenvale, closing the campaign against the cult in Darkshore.

For weeks, the Tower of Althalaxx was a festering wound in northern Darkshore, held by the fanatical Cult of the Dark Strand and its shadowy masters. Tracking, gathered intelligence, and violent skirmishes dismantled the cult's operations. Its sorcerers are slain and its dark rituals broken, ending the immediate danger of demonic infiltration in Darkshore.

After the cult leader's death, Balthule Shadowstrike sends you south to Maestra's Post, beneath the Ashenvale canopy. Delgren the Purifier waits there, a devoted warrior of the Holy Light who oversaw the fight against Althalaxx's wicked occupants. Your report of the cult's collapse brings peace of mind to the regional defenders, and Delgren gives you his lasting blessing and gratitude.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: For all the work that you have done, you deserve to be well rewarded. Return to Delgren and tell him that Athrikus Narassin lies stilled by your hand, and the Cult of the Dark Strand is beaten and scattered.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I knew you would be up to the task, friend.
I sense great deeds before you, and that you will right many of the wrongs that plague our lands. Bear my blessings, friend, as well as this gift.
